title: New In Box Pokémon Battle Figure Alolan Muk Articulated 2018 Wicked Cool Toys
descriptionText:
Get ready to battle with this amazing Pokémon Alolan Muk action figure from Wicked Cool Toys! This 1:12 scale figure is perfect for fans of the Pokémon franchise and features articulation for dynamic posing. With its vibrant multicolor design and intricate details, this figure is sure to impress.

Whether you're a collector or simply looking for a fun toy to play with, this Pokémon Battle Figure is a great choice. It's boxed and ready for display, and comes with a seal of approval from the featured person/artist. Don't miss your chance to add this Animated Adventures series figure to your collection.
